APPENDIX III
COLLECTED WRITINGS ATTRIBUTED TO THE SERVANT OF GOD FATHER SOLANUS CASEY, O.F.M.Cap.
This Appendix contains some letters, cards, and autographs addressed to individuals, all of which were re- ceived by the Vice-Postulation after 1984. Included is Notebook Number 12 only discovered in August 1987.
